verdict.rationale: Wise Business is a payments and banking platform with APIs, not an AI agent or host application that would consume tools from MCP servers, so the MCP-client axis is a category error for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in assistant or agent that could act as an MCP client; the evidence covers only payments, card, and webhook APIs and an llms.txt file.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
